transcript.said: One team — that’s the more common of the two answers. So the follow-up matters: which of the two patterns in the graphic is closer to how that team’s day actually runs?

text: One team. That’s the more common of the two answers.
So the follow-up matters. Which of the two patterns is closer to how that team’s day really runs?
chat.note: Same team, two very different days.

options: Pattern A: one after the other

prompts: It changes from day to day

blocks.eyebrow: One team, two ways to run the day
blocks.title: Which day is closer to yours?
blocks.deck: The same three moments of the day, run two ways. Read across each row.

patterns.name: Pattern A
steps: Admissions land late in the day
patterns.detail: The team finishes one job before starting the other. New patients wait for the switch.

patterns.name: Pattern B
steps: Patients already called in for beds due to free
patterns.detail: The team works both jobs side by side. New patients are called in before their bed is free.
